policyAccounts.description: Accumulation Units Account (AUA) - 100% of each regular premium is used to purchase units and allocated to this account (premium charge 0%, PDF p.5). AUA-only product (single account); the Top-up Units Account only receives the excluded recurring-single/top-up premiums. The 5% premium charge applies only to those excluded premiums (PDF p.10). Policy charge and surrender charge are both levied on the AUA / Total Investment Value (PDF p.10-11).

policyAccountFees.description: Policy Charge (years 1-12) - Monthly Policy Charge = (Policy Charge % / 12) x Total Investment Value, deducted monthly in advance on each Policy Monthiversary through unit deduction from the AUA (PDF p.10). FLAT 2.45% p.a. for policy years 1-12 (non-escalating; constant rate applied to the prevailing base each month). Per-annum rate table (PDF p.10): years 1-12 = 2.45%, years 13+ = 0.60%. Modeled as a recurring row for policy years 1-12 (MIP), then chained by the separate perpetual 0.60% row below. Continues to be deducted even during non-payment of regular premium.

Policy Charge (year 13 onwards) - Monthly Policy Charge = (0.60% per annum / 12) x Total Investment Value, deducted monthly in advance on each Policy Monthiversary through unit deduction from the AUA (PDF p.10). FLAT 0.60% p.a. from policy year 13 onwards (PDF p.10 per-annum rate table: '13 and onwards 0.60%'). Unlike the 5.10 variant, this charge does NOT stop after the minimum investment period - it persists perpetually at the reduced 0.60% rate (no 'no policy charges after MIP' statement in this Product Summary; the table explicitly continues at 0.60%). Modeled as a perpetual row starting from policy year 13. Continues to be deducted even during non-payment of regular premium.
